Tabata Timer: Workout in seconds and Studio in minutes. Free timer, no account needed.

Use the switch beside Tabata Timer: Workout uses seconds and Study uses minutes. Your last mode is remembered. Programs, activity history and statistics are separate; theme and palette are shared. End the timer before switching modes.

In Workout, each exercise has its own recovery. When moving to the next block, recovery between blocks is used: it is not added to the last exercise\'s recovery.\nThere is no recovery after the final work interval. Active work and recovery phases last at least 5 seconds; recovery between blocks is required. Cooldown is optional and lasts at least 10 seconds when enabled.
One sigh: recovery within the same block begins.
Two sighs: recovery between different blocks begins.
Two dings: a new cycle or the next block begins; they replace the single ding.
Three dings: the final work interval ends.
During cooldown: visual timer only, with no additional starting signal or countdown beeps. The same three dings sound again at its end. Without cooldown, only the three end-of-work dings are played.
The countdown plays one short note on 3, one on 2 and one on 1.\nThe initial 20-second preparation is separate from the workout duration.

In Study, add activities and set Focus, Sessions and Break. Each activity\'s break applies only between its sessions; Break between activities applies only between consecutive activities. There is no final break. The preview names the activity or transition for each break. Study keeps its current sounds: a whistle when focus starts, a sigh when a break starts and a final bell, with preparation and the 3-2-1 countdown.
In Workout choose Save workout; in Study choose Save study program. Enter a name and confirm Save on device. Find the program in the collection for the same mode.

On the web, use the same browser, profile and address. Android saves inside the app. To transfer data or keep an independent copy, use Settings → Export JSON backup and import it on the other device. Before replacing an archive, export it if you want to keep it.
In Settings choose Light or Dark and a palette: Purple, Blue, Light green, Dark green, Sky blue, Orange, Yellow, Red, Pink. Theme, palette and language are shared across modes and remembered locally.
One ding starts work; two dings start a new cycle or block. Two sighs announce recovery between blocks. Three dings end work and cooldown; the timer stays silent during cooldown.

Previous workout: personal recovery also applies between exercises and cycles; block recovery replaces it between blocks. New minimum durations apply only to the execution copy. Check the preview duration. The original stays in the archive until you save.
